list.name: Bobby's Mum：
list.en: Baby, have some water.

list.name: Bobby：
list.en: No, thanks. Can I have some bread, please?

list.name: Bobby's Mum：
list.en: Ok, wait a minute.

list.name: Tom：
list.en: Morning! What's your name?

list.name: Bobby：
list.en: Bobby.

list.name: Tom：
list.en: I'm Tom. You are a big boy! How old are you?

list.name: Bobby：
list.en: I'm 2.

list.name: Tom：
list.en: Look at your head. I like it!

list.name: Bobby：
list.en: Thank you.

list.name: Tom：
list.en: Look at your face. I LIKE it!

list.name: Bobby：
list.en: Thanks.

list.name: Tom：
list.en: Look at your body. I LIKE it!

list.name: Bobby's Mum：
list.en: Hey cat! Go away!
What's that? It's a cat.
How old are you? I five years old.
Have some eggs. No, thank you. I'd like some bread.
Let's make a puppet. Great, this is the leg.
I have a book. Me too!
Colour it brown. OK!

A-B-C-D-E-F-G, sing a song of A-B-C.Come on, boys, and come on girls. Sing a song of A-B-C. A for apple, B for book, C for cat and D for dog; E for egg and F for foot; G for girl and H for hand; I for ice cream, J for jump; K for kite and L for leg; M for milk and N for nose; O for orange and P for pen; Q for queen and R for rice; S for Sarah and T for ten;U for umbrella, V for vet, W for water, X for fox; Y for yellow, Z for zoo. It's so simple all can do!Come on boys and come on girls. Sing a song of A-B-C.
